_about: Feel knobs (docs/pivot/combat_api.md 4.9). Starting guesses; Ross tunes them in the feel panel and sends the saved file back. Each owner edits only their own group: movement and camera and sandbox (Gameplay), combat and flare (Battle), fx (Technical Artist).

knobs.label: Enemy aggression
knobs.hint: How often enemies attack. Higher means shorter pauses between attacks.

knobs.label: Enemies attacking at once
knobs.hint: How many enemies may attack at the same moment. More is harder.

knobs.label: Enemy reaction time
knobs.hint: How slowly enemies notice your swings before dodging or blocking. Higher is slower.

knobs.label: Attack wind-up length
knobs.hint: Longer wind-ups are easier to parry. Never shorter than the safe minimum.

knobs.label: Enemy dodging
knobs.hint: How often agile enemies sidestep your attacks. 0 turns dodging off.

knobs.label: Enemy blocking
knobs.hint: How often heavy enemies raise their guard. 0 turns blocking off.

knobs.label: Enemy spacing
knobs.hint: How far enemies hold back while circling you. Lower packs them in close.

knobs.label: Enemy health
knobs.hint: Multiplies every enemy's health.

knobs.label: Wounded enemies flee
knobs.hint: Low-health Cyberwolves may run away. Off makes them fight to the end.

knobs.label: Wounded enemies flank
knobs.hint: Low-health Cyberwolves may circle round to your back.

knobs.label: Brute enrage
knobs.hint: The Brute flies into a rage at low health: faster, hits more often, guards less.

knobs.label: How a hack is picked
knobs.hint: Pick then fire: choose a hack with d-pad left/right (keys 1 to 4), then fire it. Automatic: the hack button picks for you by what is around Red; hold it to Reboot.

knobs.label: Battery from sword hits
knobs.hint: How fast sword hits fill the hack battery. Higher means more hacks per fight.

knobs.label: Hack cost
knobs.hint: Multiplies what every hack costs from the battery (Reboot always takes the whole battery). Lower means more casts.

knobs.label: Hack cooldown
knobs.hint: Multiplies the wait before the same hack can be cast again. 0 turns cooldowns off.

knobs.label: Hack damage
knobs.hint: Multiplies the damage of Zap Drone and EMP (and any damage a hijacked enemy does).

knobs.label: Zap Drone pierce
knobs.hint: How many enemies one Zap Drone can pass through before it is spent.

knobs.label: EMP radius
knobs.hint: How far the EMP ring reaches around Red.

knobs.label: EMP push
knobs.hint: How far the EMP pushes enemies away from Red. 0 only stuns and breaks guards.

knobs.label: EMP stun time
knobs.hint: Multiplies how long EMP knocks drones, turrets and robots out for (2.5 to 4 seconds at 1).

knobs.label: Overclock length
knobs.hint: How many seconds a hijacked turret, drone or robot fights for Red.

knobs.label: Reboot heal
knobs.hint: How much of Red's health a full Reboot restores.

knobs.label: Reboot needs a full battery
knobs.hint: On: Reboot only works with a full battery. Off: it works from half a battery and heals less the less you have.

knobs.label: Automatic: hold to Reboot
knobs.hint: Only in Automatic. How long you hold the hack button before it Reboots instead of picking an attack.

knobs.label: Automatic: crowd size for EMP
knobs.hint: Only in Automatic. How many enemies close to Red make the hack button fire EMP instead of Zap Drone.

knobs.label: Free hacks (testing)
knobs.hint: Hacks cost nothing and the battery stays full. For trying every hack without earning it.

knobs.label: Slow time in the hack list
knobs.hint: Slows the game while the hack list is open, so you can pick without rushing. Off: the game keeps running while you browse.

knobs.label: Hack list slow-down
knobs.hint: How slow the game runs while the hack list is open (only when the switch above is on). Lower is slower.

knobs.label: Heap damage
knobs.hint: Multiplies what the Heap's attacks do to the colossus. Lower is more forgiving.

knobs.label: Heap plate health
knobs.hint: Multiplies the armour plates' health (read when the Heap is built). Lower means a shorter plate phase.

knobs.label: Heap pause between attacks
knobs.hint: Multiplies the pause between the Heap's attacks. Higher gives more time to hit the open plate.
